_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative lifecycle, imperative cross-app command
_meta.description: The counter sale of design.md D6 (REQ-RPPO-006): an ARInvoice flagged simplifiedInvoice and counterSale is created as a draft, paid on the user's phone, issued on capture and cancelled when the payment fails or the customer walks away. Adds the two flags, the cancelled state and the cancel transition from draft. A cancelled draft has booked nothing: the issue transition, which books the invoice, never ran. The ARInvoice version is moved in zz-financial-documents-linked-objects.json, which has the last word on it.
